unlock_hint: Complete level N to unlock N+1.
level_complete: Level {n} completed! The next one is unlocked.
lose_message: A trap got you. Try again!
level_01_hint: Dodge the traps, then climb to the exit!
level_02_hint: Push the crate and jump onto it to clear the wall.
level_03_hint: SHIFT creates a bridge. The blue laser is dangerous when SHIFT is ON.
level_04_hint: Orange lasers pulse. Wait for an opening.
level_05_hint: Climb onto the platform and find the yellow card.
level_06_hint: Avoid the patrols, get the keycard, then head back.
level_07_hint: The spring launches you over the high wall.
level_08_hint: Fast conveyor! Jump on the monster to stop it.
level_09_hint: Jump on the monster, activate the switch, then return to the exit.
level_10_hint: Combine saws, conveyors, monsters and backtracking to reach the exit!
level_11_hint: Push the crate, jump the gap and SHIFT past the laser.
level_12_hint: Watch the longer saw sweep before you jump.
level_14_hint: Switch SHIFT ON and OFF to cross the lasers.
level_15_hint: Climb the extra wall and time the saw.
level_16_hint: Two crates, two monsters: plan your jumps.
level_17_hint: Push a crate onto the plate, then press both switches.
level_18_hint: Two wide-moving saws: jump at the right time.
level_19_hint: Five monsters and three saws guard the path.
level_20_hint: Keep a crate on the plate and toggle SHIFT four times.
required_plate: PLACE A CRATE ON THE PLATE!
level_21_hint: Push the sliding bridge over the gap, cross, come back, then push the crate onto the switch.
level_22_hint: Push the wheel onto the plate, then run past the disabled laser before time runs out.
level_23_hint: Place crates on switches 1 and 4, then land on the three moving platforms in order.
level_24_hint: Put two crates and the hero on the plate, then move one crate to the spring.
level_25_hint: Find the five correct crates. Only the number of correct positions is shown.
level_26_hint: Rotate the wheel to one angle, then cross the gap.
level_27_hint: Collect prime numbers in order: finish with 17. Avoid decoys.
level_28_hint: Match crates to opposite plates, then push the spring to its marker.
level_29_hint: Complete GAME with OVER: collect O, V, E, R in order.
level_30_hint: Complete both sequences, then cross the gravity and reversed-control zones.
level_31_hint: Push the bridge over the gap; combine weights 2 and 3 on the plate.
level_32_hint: Collect R A G U S, then rotate the wheel to 180 degrees.
level_33_hint: Put weights 2 and 3 on plates 1 and 3; ride the platform into the gravity zone.
level_34_hint: Activate the plate, then release it; move the spring to its marker.
level_35_hint: Pick 25, jump over the wall and the moving spike.
level_36_hint: Arrange the crates in descending odd order, then activate RADAR.
level_37_hint: Collect 2, 3, 5, 7; use the inverted-gravity zone and land on the platform.
level_38_hint: Turn the wheel to 270 degrees, swap the crate plates, move the spring.
level_39_hint: Collect SWEET in order, hold down the plate and visit the false door.
level_40_hint: Complete the series, place total weight 5, set 90 degrees, activate the word panel, then move the bridge.
